event: I've submitted the verdict, and it was accepted. I withdrew all five items as already tested. The hmac DV environment (`hw/ip/hmac/dv/env`) randomizes illegal and all-zero `key_length` and `digest_size` values, and it writes MSG_FIFO with random sub-word byte masks. The scoreboard predicts the Key_None and SHA2_None mapping and the per-word endian swap, so wrong behavior fails the CFG read check or the digest compare. I didn't run any tests, and I didn't check which tests reach the smoke sequence.
